title: Filled, Not Controlled
body:
**“Be filled with the Spirit.”**

Everyone is influenced by something. Pressure, approval, anger, addiction or ambition can quietly take control.

Paul contrasts being controlled by wine with being filled by the Holy Spirit. To be filled is to come under the Spirit’s holy influence—allowing Him to shape our worship, gratitude, relationships and choices.

This is not a one-time emotional experience or permission to lose self-control. The same Spirit produces self-control. His work makes people more like Jesus, not more impressed with themselves.

Ask what is directing you today. Yield the words, plans and desires you have been protecting. Ask the Spirit to fill what fear, pride or appetite has been controlling.

A Spirit-filled life is a surrendered life.
